extraction: Exact original 48-byte VAG header plus unmodified ADPCM payload

entries.embedded_english: Someone get on the radio and tell the captain Shuri Castle is now property of the US Marine Corps.  Polonsky, Turner, Jackson, secure the area…
Push through it! We've got to get to cover!
We've got push through to the castle!
Miller - We need to get closer to that castle gate! Come on!
Okay, looks like we're going right down their throats.  Press up!
Miller, plant a charge on the gate.  That's an order!
Miller's going for it.  Cover him!
Enemy to the east!  Over by that gate.
Miller, pick up that Bazooka and take out that tank!
The walls!   Get behind the walls!
MG! Top of the staircase to the North East!
On me!  We've got to get up those stairs!
Get in there, Marines! Go go!
Looks like more of the fight took place in here Sarge…
Ah hell, we've got another MG!
Doesn't seem like it.  <pause>  You getting the same bad  feeling I'm getting, Polonsky?
I can hear AA fire up ahead Sarge…
Pour every round you got on that gate!
We've got 'em coming from the west!
Hold em off! Argh! They're everywhere!
Alright, lets move out, take it slow.. They're waiting for us…
Hold up, we wait here for an artillery strike!
Why isn't that damn bunker out of action?
We've got an MG nest at the gate!
Damn it, we need to get to that gate!
Not with that MG nest in the way.  Miller, get to the gate and deploy a charge.  The rest of you - give him covering fire!
Carter - get on the radio and find out if another squad came through here….
More of them in the windows
Hold on!  Air Force is on its way!
Marines! We need to get to that bunker line! Step on it!
We've got some more friendly company.  Let's hit 'em together!
Get back here and take cover, Miller!
Okay, let's get inside that castle….
Move up.  Get to the stairs!
Reinforcements coming from the north east!
Hold up guys… take it nice and slow…
Miller, I want you on point.  Go take a look...
Nice place.  <pause>  Hasn't even been scratched by the battle so far.  <pause> Sarge, any other units made it this far  forward ahead of us?
Okay, we're going out into the courtyard.  Watch your backs, guys.
Japanese sure like their doors big an heavy...
That'll be what's stopping our guys leveling this place, we've got to take them out! Come on!
Cover me!, Damn it! Over there!
That's the plan, Polonsky.  That's the plan...

Okay guys. That's Shuri Castle up ahead.    Word is,  the flyboys have spotted heavy resistance inside…    Which figures, 'cos the general wants this place taken, and we're the guys who are going to have to do the taking.
We got smoke, Sarge. They known we're here!
Lay down some smoke before it chews us to pieces!
Watch your backs,Marines.  They're still coming!
Come on guys, with me… We need to find the central courtyard.

Alright.  Stack up.  The castle courtyard must be through these doors.  The flyboys are waiting to come in and flatten this place into matchwood, so we need to finish this sweep.  Mr Polonsky, would you do the honors?
The rest of you,  stay alert.
If I'm going down, I'm going down fighting!
Could be a hundred, could be a thousand.  Enough to keep us busy, that's for sure.
